# Quiz 2 - Binary, hex and two's complement {.unnumbered}

Four options, exactly one correct. Drag - or tap - one answer
into the answer box of each question. As in the exam, there is
no penalty for guessing - fill every box, then grade. Wrong
answers get an explanation and a link into the script.
